question: Using UV1's rule with a 1-hour hold, is there any entry minute, direction (fade or follow), signal, ticker or weekday where SPY/QQQ stock or 0DTE first-OTM options make money beyond what chance produces in a scan this size?
inherits: UV1_MIDDAY_FADE_PREREG_20261011.json: |m| >= 1% from the 09:30 open skips; signals A (move from the open) and B (last 15-minute bar); fills at minute VWAP; options first strike OTM, same-day expiry, buy mid x 1.05, sell mid x 0.95, $0.05/contract/side; stock 1 bp per side; full sessions only

grid.entry_minutes: every minute 09:45 .. 14:59 ET (315); decision on the close of the previous minute; exit at the VWAP of the minute 60 later
grid.filter: |m_t| >= 1% skips (the market has chosen a direction as of the decision)
grid.direction: fade bets against the signal sign; follow bets with it
grid.option_fallbacks: entry: first traded minute t .. t+5 of the selected contract, none: no trade; exit: first traded minute t+60 .. t+65, else last trade t+55 .. t+65, else 0
grid.cells: {stock, option} x {A, B} x {fade, follow} x {SPY, QQQ} x {Mon .. Fri, All} x 315 minutes = 30,240; a cell needs n >= 30 trades

reading_rule.null: 200 permutations per instrument: session rows of the signal matrix are shuffled (seed 20261011), breaking only the signal-outcome link; returns, filters, weekdays and contracts' unconditional drift are kept
reading_rule.gate: a dev cell is a candidate when its t >= 2 and its t exceeds the 95th percentile of the permutation maximum t across all cells of its instrument (family-wise 5%)
reading_rule.reported: count of cells with t >= 2 against the permutation mean and 95th percentile of that count; the observed maximum t against the permutation distribution; top 20 cells per instrument
reading_rule.confirmation: candidates only: 2026 mean > 0 at base cost with t >= 1
reading_rule.single_run: the scan runs once and is reported whatever the outcome

honesty_notes: adjacent minutes overlap heavily (59 of 60 minutes shared), so cells are strongly correlated; the permutation maximum handles that, a raw t >= 2 count does not
for stock, follow is fade with the sign flipped (net of the same costs), so only one of each pair can be positive
UV1 already showed no 11:30 ET 2-hour reversal; this scan is broader exploration, and any candidate needs the 2026 confirmation and a paper period
